title: Provider architecture: break wolfSSL hard dependency
description:
crypto2dev.ko is hard-wired to wolfcrypt.ko. Every wolfCrypt type (Aes, wc_Sha256, RsaKey, etc.) is baked into crypto2dev_fd_state. We need a clean provider abstraction so that multiple crypto backends can register algorithms at load time, and crypto2dev.ko contains zero crypto code of its own.

Scope:
- New include/crypto2dev_provider.h with algo_ops vtable and provider registration API
- crypto2dev.ko becomes pure framework: chardev + registry + dispatch, no wolfCrypt symbols
- crypto2dev_wolfssl.ko becomes a new loadable provider module
- Stub mode = don't load wolfssl provider module at all
- Algo dispatch: first-registered wins

Acceptance criteria:
- crypto2dev.ko has zero wolfcrypt.ko symbol dependencies
- A second provider module can be loaded alongside wolfssl provider
- All existing tests pass against wolfssl provider
